title: 第44章 斩杀恶鬼，任务完成
content_zh:
第44章 斩杀恶鬼，任务完成-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

上一章

存书签

下一章

三名一等鬼差虽然实力强大，但联手攻击，也只能勉强压制住恶鬼，而且渐渐落入了下风。

一个不注意，大叔鬼差被扫了一记，瞬间口吐黑血，身受重伤，只能勉强支撑着，再也不能发动攻击了。

吴姜也打得十分艰难，幸好有鬼柳环的防御，要不然，绝对和大叔同样的下场。

但即便如此，他也渐渐体力不支，阴气消耗巨大，嘴角也溢出了一丝黑血。

就在这时，意外发生了。

一名一等鬼差急于建功，贸然发动攻击，被恶鬼抓住破绽，一把掐住了脖子，恶鬼发出一阵狞笑，猛地用力，那名一等鬼差发出一声凄厉的惨叫，身体渐渐变得透明，最终魂飞魄散，彻底消失在了空气中。

看到这一幕，众人脸色大变，心中充满了恐惧和愤怒。

另外两名一等鬼差，脸色更加的难看，同僚就在面前被打了一个魂飞魄散，谁能忍得了。

“可恶！”吴姜也是怒骂一声，但却没有丝毫的办法。

愤怒之下，两位一等鬼差已经开始拼命了，燃烧自身阴气，施展出了搏命之法，向着恶鬼扑杀过去。

恶鬼别看刚刚凶威勃发，杀了一名鬼差，但他自身也受了一定的伤势。

现在看到两个鬼差彻底拼命，张阿彪心中顿时有了退却之意。

他倒不是害怕这几个鬼差，给他时间，绝对能将这几个鬼差全部留在这里，要是能吞吃了，实力更是能够大进。

但是就怕地府的援兵过来，他可不信，眼前的鬼差，没有报信的本事。

只是，他想走，也没那么简单，其中一个鬼差已经不要命了，显然是和那个死去的鬼差，交情匪浅，此刻不顾自己的伤势，已经死死的缠住了恶鬼。

为首的鬼差，实力已经是鬼卒境巅峰，距离突破鬼尉境，也只是一步之遥。

虽然这一步之遥，可能是遥不可及，但在拼命的打法之下，给恶鬼同样造成了不小的伤势。

吴姜此刻也发狠了，仗着鬼柳环的防御，拼死将手中的斩魂剑刺进了恶鬼的身体。

Chapter 44: Kill the evil ghost, the mission is completed - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of God"

Previous chapter

Save bookmarks

Next chapter

Although the three first-class ghosts were powerful, they could only barely suppress the evil ghosts when they attacked together, and they gradually fell into a disadvantage.

Without paying attention, Uncle Guizha was struck by a blow. He instantly vomited black blood and was seriously injured. He could only hold on and could no longer attack.

Wu Jiang also had a very difficult fight. Fortunately, he had Gui Liuhuan's defense, otherwise, he would definitely end up with the same fate as his uncle.

But even so, he gradually lost strength, consumed a huge amount of Yin Qi, and a trace of black blood overflowed from the corner of his mouth.

Just then, an accident happened.

A first-class ghost sergeant was eager to make a contribution and launched an attack rashly. The evil spirit caught the flaw and strangled his neck. The evil ghost let out a ferocious laugh and exerted force. The first-class ghost sergeant let out a shrill scream. His body gradually became transparent, and finally his soul flew away and completely disappeared into the air.

Seeing this scene, everyone's expressions changed drastically, and their hearts were filled with fear and anger.

The other two first-class ghost officers looked even more ugly. Their colleagues were beaten to death right in front of them. Who could bear it?

"Damn it!" Wu Jiang also yelled angrily, but there was nothing he could do.

In anger, the two first-class ghost officers began to fight with all their strength, burning their own yin energy, using life-threatening methods, and pounced on the evil ghost.

Despite the fact that the evil ghost had just unleashed its ferocious power and killed a ghost servant, he himself also suffered some injuries.

Now that he saw the two ghosts working hard, Zhang Abiao suddenly felt like retreating.

He is not afraid of these ghosts. If you give him time, he can definitely keep all these ghosts here. If he can swallow them, his strength will be greatly improved.

But he was afraid that reinforcements from the underworld would come, and he didn't believe it. The ghost in front of him didn't have the ability to report the news.

However, if he wanted to leave, it was not that simple. One of the ghosts was already dead. He obviously had a close friendship with the dead ghost. At this moment, regardless of his own injuries, he had already clung to the evil ghost.

The leader of the group, Guizhan, is already at the peak of the Ghost Soldier Realm, and is only one step away from breaking through to the Ghost Captain Realm.

Although this step may be out of reach, the desperate fighting style also caused a lot of injuries to the evil spirit.

Wu Jiang also became fierce at this moment. Relying on Ghost Liuhuan's defense, he desperately stabbed the soul-cutting sword in his hand into the evil ghost's body.
